tips.text: Do the daily KIM conversation before ranking up or gifting; either can end that day's pending conversation.
Chat with every Hex member each day from the start; chemistry earned while rank-capped is kept.
Keep one of each small treasure instead of trading them all in; Rank 3 and Rank 5 each eat a full set.
Use Parallax's air support to ping Hex Treasures on the map.
Abandon and reroll a Höllvania bounty whose objective fails to spawn.
Watch life support in a Survival with an open vault; spawns can starve.
Take other Hex gear as bounty-reward blueprints instead of buying it, so standing goes into rank-ups.
Buy the EFV-8 Mars from Minerva on the same visit.
Spend your free Rank 5 vendor item on the 15,000 standing main blueprint if Minerva's stock allows it.
Players call the Hex grind easy and fair; the daily standing cap sets the pace.
Treat it as a mastery pickup; players find the long alt-fire charge lukewarm.
